missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Министр' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'выступает'. 'Новый' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'сегодня вечером' adds time. A natural news opener.

Strategic focus: Accusative animate. 'Министра' is the accusative direct object of 'ждут'; for this animate masculine noun the form matches the genitive. 'У входа' shows the place. Useful for animacy practice.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Нового министра' is the genitive showing whose speech it is. 'Нового' agrees in the masculine genitive. A clean of-relationship pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Министру' is the dative required by 'аплодировали'. 'Долго' adds duration. Good for verbs that govern the dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'С министром' uses the instrumental 'министром' after 'с' to mean together with. 'Встретился' marks the meeting. A core companionship pattern.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О новом министре' uses the prepositional 'министре' after 'о' to mark the topic. 'Новом' agrees in the prepositional. Useful for media language.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К министру' uses the dative 'министру' after 'к' to show movement toward a person. 'Сейчас' adds immediacy. A common directional pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Министры' is the nominative plural subject of 'обсуждают'. 'Новый закон' is the accusative object. Good for describing a council at work.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural animate. 'Министров' is the accusative plural, which for this animate noun matches the genitive plural. 'Всех' agrees in the animate accusative. A clear animacy pattern.

Strategic focus: Genitive plural after preposition. 'От министров' uses the genitive plural 'министров' after 'от' to mark the source. 'Правительства' is a further genitive modifier. A causal-source pattern.
